title: Masha and Cactus
statementMd:
Masha is fond of cacti. When she was a little girl, she decided to plant a tree. Now Masha wants to make a nice cactus out of her tree.

Recall that tree is a connected undirected graph that has no cycles. Cactus is a connected undirected graph such that each vertex belongs to at most one cycle.

Masha has some additional edges that she can add to a tree. For each edge she knows which vertices it would connect and the beauty of this edge. Masha can add some of these edges to the graph if the resulting graph is a cactus. Beauty of the resulting cactus is sum of beauties of all added edges.

Help Masha find out what maximum beauty of the resulting cactus she can achieve.

## Input

The first line of the input data contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ — the number of vertices in a tree, and the number of additional edges available ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$; $0 ≤ *m* ≤ 2·10^{5}$).

Let us describe Masha's tree. It has a root at vertex 1. The second line contains $*n* - 1$ integers: $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$, here $*p*_{*i*}$ — is the parent of a vertex $*i*$ — the first vertex on a path from the vertex $*i*$ to the root of the tree ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} < *i*$).

The following $*m*$ lines contain three integers $*u*_{*i*}$, $*v*_{*i*}$ and $*c*_{*i*}$ — pairs of vertices to be connected by the additional edges that Masha can add to the tree and beauty of edge ($1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$; $*u*_{*i*} ≠ *v*_{*i*}$; $1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4}$).

It is guaranteed that no additional edge coincides with the edge of the tree.

## Output

Output one integer — the maximum beauty of a cactus Masha can achieve.
statementZhMd:
玛莎很喜欢仙人掌。小时候，她决定种一棵树。现在，玛莎想把她的树变成一棵漂亮的仙人掌。

回顾一下，树是一个连通的无向无环图。仙人掌是一个连通的无向图，并且每个顶点至多属于一个环。

玛莎有一些可以添加到树上的额外边。对于每条边，她都知道这条边连接的顶点以及这条边的美丽值。如果添加某些边后得到的图是一个仙人掌，玛莎就可以将这些边添加到图中。得到的仙人掌的美丽值，是所有添加边的美丽值之和。

请帮助玛莎求出她能够得到的仙人掌的最大美丽值。

## 输入格式

输入数据的第一行包含两个整数 $*n* and *m*$ ——树中的顶点数，以及可用的额外边数（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$；$0 ≤ *m* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）。

下面描述玛莎的树。树的根为顶点 1。第二行包含 $*n* - 1$ 个整数：$*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$，其中 $*p*_{*i*}$ 是顶点 $*i*$ 的父节点，即从顶点 $*i*$ 到树根的路径上经过的第一个顶点（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} < *i*$）。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行，每行包含三个整数 $*u*_{*i*}$、$*v*_{*i*}$ 和 $*c*_{*i*}$ ——玛莎可以添加到树中的额外边所连接的顶点，以及该边的美丽值（$1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$；$*u*_{*i*} ≠ *v*_{*i*}$；$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4}$）。

保证没有额外边与树中的边重合。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数 ——玛莎能够得到的仙人掌的最大美丽值。
